[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Time-based key-value store** [LC 981 · Time Based Key-Value Store](https://leetcode.com/problems/time-based-key-value-store/){difficulty="Medium"}

Because timestamps only increase, appending to a per-key list keeps it sorted for free. Each `get` is "largest timestamp $\le t$" in that list: `bisect_right(times, t) - 1`.

[Solved in full in @sec-lang-p4-timemap.]{.card-link}
